title: Reliable Cross-Device Cloud Loading
notes: Prevents a selected Home cloud document from silently falling back to the existing local Shot Diagram during cross-page loading.
Carries the selected cloud revision into the target workspace and removes the pending request only after the snapshot is applied successfully.
Retains a server-fetch fallback for documents too large for the temporary page handoff.
Clarifies the difference between Continue device copy and Load cloud.
Preserves the m40.7.0 dashboard, streamlined Cloud Sync, and verified m40.6.2 editing behavior.
